name: The Hidden Niche
summary: After uncovering the talkative remains of Alaric from a shallow grave outside Fenris Keep, adventurers are directed back inside the stronghold. Guided by the deceased human's memories, travelers seek out a forgotten alcove concealed behind a dusty shelf to grant him final repose and claim an old relic.

sections.title: A Restless Request
sections.body: Even after death, Alaric retains vivid memories of Fenris Keep during its better days. Relieved to be exhumed from a shallow, unceremonious dirt grave by Horde scouts, his skeletal remains refuse to simply be carried off to the Sepulcher. Instead, he bargains with vital information: a hidden niche inside the keep's southwestern tower containing an item deeply treasured by Thule Ravenclaw and his fellow mages.

sections.title: Buried in the Walls
sections.body: Navigating past the Rot Hide gnolls infesting the island fortress, travelers carry Alaric's remains up through the stone corridors. Tucked away behind a dusty bookshelf in the upper levels lies the secret compartment he spoke of. Once opened, Alaric asks only to be sealed away within the keep's ancient masonry, finding solace in resting inside the walls where he spent the happiest days of his life—far from the gnawing jaws of the gnolls.

faq.answer: Alaric was a resident or defender of Fenris Keep prior to its overrun by the Rot Hide gnolls and Thule Ravenclaw's necromancy. Discovered buried outside the fortress in a shallow grave, his animated spirit helps guide Horde adventurers in exchange for a proper resting place inside his beloved stronghold.

faq.q: Where is the hidden niche located?
faq.answer: The hidden niche is concealed inside the southwestern tower of Fenris Keep, hidden behind an unassuming, dusty bookshelf on the upper floor.

faq.q: What item is hidden in the alcove?
faq.answer: Inside the concealed alcove rests an old wand once treasured by Thule Ravenclaw and his former peers from Dalaran, along with other remnants Alaric leaves for those who aided him.

faq.q: Why does Alaric want to stay inside Fenris Keep?
faq.answer: Alaric considers the time he spent living within Fenris Keep to be the best days of his life. Sealing his remains within the stonework brings him peace and keeps him safe from the scavenger gnolls roaming the courtyards.

faq.q: What happens after finding the shelf?
aliases: what do i do with the wand
faq.answer: After sealing Alaric into the niche and retrieving the wand, adventurers are directed back to the Undercity to deliver the relic to Bethor Iceshard.

faq.q: Why did Alaric tell you to leave his boots behind?
faq.answer: When his bones were exhumed from the shallow grave, Alaric humorously insisted on leaving his old boots in the dirt, remarking that they never fit him properly anyway.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, dealing with restless, speaking remains is familiar business, though Alaric's yearning for peaceful rest in human ruins is a stark reminder of the lands they inherited.
The hidden alcove preserves the arcane heritage of Fenris Keep, concealing artifacts tied directly to former Dalaran wizards like Thule Ravenclaw.
Reclaiming relics from the heart of Fenris Keep undermines Thule's foothold on Fenris Isle and assists the Forsaken's campaign to secure Silverpine Forest.
